payload.text: Each item needs hv, and each is released as hv does it. (1) Contacts access for this terminal, or hv runs 'cargo test --test cli live -- --ignored' (ST0001 AC-09.2). (2) Create the geodica.apple.{APPLE_ID,APPLE_APP_PASSWORD,APPLE_TEAM_ID} keychain entries. (3) Allow Developer ID signing, the identity check and the first notarytool submission (ST0002 WP07, AC-07.1 and 07.2). (4) Intent fixes outside pplr: the pre-commit hook's word-splitting, AGENTS.md's swift lines, and the estate page's false orphaned holds (watchouts 1 to 3). (5) WP13 cutover moves ~/.local/bin/pplr to the Rust binary. (6) ST0002 WP05: the real brew install from a scratch tap; dc prepares everything up to it (it could shadow ~/.local/bin/pplr). (7) ST0002 WP04. The tap's description and CI need gh repo edit and a tap push (AC-04.2). For AC-04.1, dc measured the render clean, but brew style refuses the manifest header devbin generates (131 columns against brew's 118, lib/cmd/formula:424); Homebrew forbids the RuboCop wrap, and one element per line passes, so file the Devbin issue dc wrote (banked by dc on a local branch; dc names it). And brew audit --strict refuses an untrusted tap: allow it with `brew trust --formula dc/pplrscratch/pplr`, one entry in ~/.homebrew/trust.json that `brew untrust` removes, or say no. (9) ST0001 AT-00.7's measured red, by the CI route hv chose (2026-11-03): push the branch cc built, candidate/wp13-at007-red (tip 116a607: main eb7e9b8, the AT-00.7 test and a mutant dropping the handler's macOS gate, reviewed by vc), with `git push upstream candidate/wp13-at007-red`, and delete it once CI has reported, with `git push upstream --delete candidate/wp13-at007-red`; ubuntu's failure of that test is the red. Each push is hv's, from the terminal: the auto-mode classifier refuses one from vc's session.
